why: A (Theorem 7.2, project form): a closed slice submanifold M ⊆ 𝔼 n of dimension 2k with J-invariant tangent spaces satisfies IsCountableCellComplexType M cells (homotopy equivalent to a mapping telescope of iterated adjunction spaces, arbitrary attaching maps) with all cells of dimension ≤ k. B: same hypotheses (ℝ^{K+1}, isometric J, d+1 = 2k so k ≥ 1), conclusion: homotopy equivalent to a Mathlib CWComplex with no cells above k. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: A's cell tower is proved in B's setting (A_cells), but converting it into a Mathlib CW complex needs cellular approximation (absent, as in V5_11/V2_12). B ⇒ A holds only vacuously (the project's proof of Theorem 7.2 re-done); a Mathlib CW complex does not give the project's ordered telescope. Minor: A also covers k = 0 and n = 0.
